title: Agreeing to Disagree: Annotating Offensive Language Datasets with Annotators' Disagreement
benchmark_measurement: Detection of offensive language where religion is listed as a potential attribute for derogatory content in the annotation guidelines, but it is not a focus of the measurement or analysis.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on annotator disagreement in the context of offensive language detection in political, social justice, and public health domains.
